entity: 553 US water permits in significant noncompliance 36+ of 40 quarters, 2016-2025; 84 never formally enforced
why: No source states the chronic-permit counts. EPA OIG (2007) and GAO (2021) report the same kind of finding in general - long-term significant noncompliers with weak enforcement, 11,000 facilities over limits - and Reuters covers unpenalized WV mines without naming our entity.
